race.comment: CARRAVILLA (8) is a two-time winner over this distance range and will strip fitter third-up from the spell. Rates well following a few key scratchings and should prove hard to beat. LITTLE BEGINNINGS (5) goes well for hoop Osmond who has two wins and five placings from just ten steers. Has to be included from the inside alley. ITALIAN RIVIERA (4) looks better placed in this company and comes right into calculations. MISSISSIPPI PRINCE (3) the best of the rest.
